mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising real discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in periods where FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 exceeding 2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 falls by more than 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which raises wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 4% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in INDPRO and a fall in HOUST over two months indicates supply-side inflation with weakening housing demand, which erodes corporate earnings power and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 0% change and HOUST < 0% change over two months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO rises and HOUST falls over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in PAYEMS by more than 1% month-over-month signals accelerated job losses, which increases recession risk and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS falls by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated fall in both FEDFUNDS and RSAFS below their respective 12-month averages signals a synchronized easing in monetary and fiscal policy, which supports risk assets and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 12mo avg and RSAFS < 12mo avg simultaneously
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both FEDFUNDS and RSAFS fall below their 12-month averages simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPIAUCSL above 3% for four consecutive months signals entrenched inflation, which prompts central bank tightening and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% for four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in INDPRO and a decrease in UNRATE over two months indicates a supply-side expansion with softening labor market conditions, which boosts profit margins and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO > 0% change and UNRATE < 0% change over two months
regime_hint: supply expansion with soft labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO rises and UNRATE falls over two months.
